message: fix(inventory): retain native item slots across selection and snapshot refresh
purpose: Preserve the integrated hunting, dash, Atelier, native-pixel and early progression work. Avoid destroying native item slots on ordinary selection and server updates. Rebuild only when membership, ordering, templates, bag or grouping changes. Add native mouse, focus, current-data, removal and group-transfer tests at both supported resolutions. No inventory capacity or server rules change.

replacements.old: private ItemSlot MakeSlot(Item item, string bag, Action? clicked = null)

TooltipText = ItemDescription(item) + (Data.Item(item.Template).Type == "tool" ? "

Keep this tool in your backpack. The best learned tool is selected automatically." : "

Double-click: equip or unequip. Right-click: item actions."),
